rubric.role_summary: Senior analytics engineer working across Product and GTM to build data models, pipelines, metrics, analyses, reporting, and operational data workflows.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior analytics engineer working across Product and GTM to build data models, pipelines, metrics, analyses, reporting, and operational data workflows.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or data engineering.
- Hands-on experience with SQL, dbt, and a cloud data warehouse.
- Data modeling experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a fast-moving software company.
- Exceptional SQL and strong hands-on experience with dbt and a modern cloud data warehouse.
- End-to-end ownership of data projects, from shaping an ambiguous problem to shipping a relied-on solution.
- Data modeling expertise covering grain, reusable components, interfaces, dependencies, and maintainability, without requiring a particular methodology.
- Experience partnering directly with both technical and non-technical teams.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: North America (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
